overview: A tuition class attendance tracker with colour-coded subjects, daily Present/Absent/Cancelled marking, and a calendar for backfilling past classes.
features: Sign in securely with Internet Identity
Add subjects and pick a colour for each tab
Swipe a subject right to delete it
Mark today's attendance as Present, Absent or Class Cancelled
Use a small calendar to add past class dates
Change a status already recorded on any date
Swipe a recorded date right to delete it
Everything saves automatically and survives refresh
